W09.MAX: Initial sheet shows heading/explanation and Done; scrolled larger detent shows all four vertically stacked 6–7 through 9–10 rows, 0–1 reps left, and Done. No row overlap observed.

limits: Phone normal prior selector failed on Skip ID before W08/W09; iPad normal pass does not rewrite that raw phone result.
